name: Cute Artist
tagline: Drawing and colouring for young artists
promise: Your drawings stay on your device. No gallery, no upload, no account.
purpose: a drawing and colouring app with classic and magic brushes, animated characters, and background music that works on your device
dataSummary: Drawings stay on your device. No account, no gallery, no upload, and no ad tracking. Only anonymous usage analytics, crash diagnostics, and static artwork downloads.

storage.summary: Your drawings, saved colourings, and preferences are created and kept on your device. We do not operate a gallery server and we do not upload your artwork anywhere.
bullets: Drawings are saved in the app's isolated sandbox storage on your device.
If you back up your device through iCloud Backup, your local Cute Artist data follows your system backup settings.
Deleting a saved colouring inside the app or deleting the Cute Artist app permanently erases your local drawings.

analyticsIntro: To keep the app stable and understand which features are used, a single analytics and diagnostics service receives limited, anonymous telemetry. It never receives your drawings, your canvas, or anything you create in the app.

analytics.name: Product analytics & diagnostics
analytics.desc: Anonymous usage events (such as app opened, artwork opened, drawing started, drawing completed or saved, background music toggled, and purchase events) plus automatic error and crash diagnostics, together with device model, operating-system version, app version, and locale. There are no accounts, so no event carries a name or email address, and none can be linked to your drawings.

thirdPartiesIntro: Apart from the analytics and diagnostics service listed above, the app only connects to our static content host to download artwork packs and background music, and to Apple for App Store purchases.

thirdParties.name: Analytics & diagnostics service
thirdParties.desc: anonymous usage events and crash/error logs as described above.

thirdParties.name: Static content host
thirdParties.desc: serves downloadable artwork packs and background music tracks. These are downloads only: the request sends nothing about you or your drawings.

thirdParties.name: Apple
thirdParties.desc: App Store distribution, in-app purchases, and purchase restoration, handled entirely by Apple.

childrenExtra: Cute Artist is made to be enjoyed by young artists, and we have deliberately kept it free of accounts, social feeds, uploads, user-generated content sharing, and advertising tracking.
rights: Clear your saved colourings: you can delete any saved drawing inside Cute Artist at any time.
Reset app data: clearing the app storage or uninstalling Cute Artist instantly and permanently deletes all local drawings and settings from your device.
No deletion request needed: because we do not store accounts or artwork on cloud servers, there is no server-side copy to request deletion of.
rightsTail: Nothing to export or request from us, because we hold no personal data or artwork about you.
